papers.canonical_title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
papers.abstract: BlenderFORGE trains open-weight multimodal agents for executable Blender scene editing through perturbation-generated tasks, an isolated state-verifiable sandbox, supervised trajectories and multi-turn reinforcement learning. Four editing families cover placement, shape keys, lighting and material parameters.

events.evidence: Canonical submission history lists v1 only; Chicago 2026-11-07 08:56:41-06:00.

source_records.evidence: Abstract and submission history; Atom unavailable.

papers.screening_reason: Trained VLM autonomously chooses execution/preview tools and emits bpy changes to explicit scene state, with render and execution feedback.
screening_evidence: Sections 3.1, 3.3–3.5; Appendix A.2 Algorithm 1 establish executable agent-to-scene transitions.
papers.analysis_target: Trained BlenderFORGE Qwen editing agent executing a task-time sandbox episode across the four editing families. Training adaptation is recorded in model_training; terminal RL rewards and data-generation filters are not misclassified as inference feedback.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Selects code-execution versus preview tools and writes bpy attribute edits
agent_graphics_relation.graphics_target: Explicit Blender objects, shape coefficients, lights and materials
agent_graphics_relation.evidence: Agent autonomously decides which tool to invoke and when; code execution updates scene and preview supplies images for subsequent turns.

task.evidence: Edits pose, shape coefficients, lighting and shader attributes.
task.reasoning: Static geometry/appearance editing is Modeling; shape-key coefficient edits do not establish animation authoring.

input_form.evidence: Initial scene, language instructions, multi-view start and goal renderings are supplied.
input_form.reasoning: Language and images are explicit task context; existing editable Blender scene is the supplied 3D representation.

output.evidence: Actions transform start scene into modified scene sm.
output.reasoning: The task product is edited explicit scene, not preview imagery or temporary action code.

model_type.evidence: Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B receive multimodal context and choose actions.

model_training.evidence: Trajectory and general SFT followed by GSPO AgentLoop-RL.

planning.locator: Appendix A.2 pp.15–16; full text planning search
planning.evidence: Reasoning traces and autonomous next-tool selection are described; no explicit task-plan representation specified for trained agent.
planning.reasoning: An action-selection loop is not enough to assign a planning degree. Baseline plan anecdotes on p.20 are not a defined planner.

workflow.evidence: Generate, parse and execute calls, append responses, repeat per episode.
workflow.reasoning: One sequential interaction path; parallel independent training episodes are not task workflow parallelism.

update_strategy.evidence: bpy changes selected attributes in current scene after observation.
update_strategy.reasoning: Localized state edits rather than regenerating whole assets.

verifier.evidence: Agent iterates from visual discrepancies; execution endpoint returns success flags and traceback.
verifier.reasoning: Self inspects visual progress; Environment returns execution validity. Terminal reward evaluator and final GPT judge are not inference critics.

feedback_assessment.evidence: Visual inspection guides edits; executor returns success flag and traceback.
feedback_assessment.reasoning: Diagnosis denotes discrepancy/error reasoning; Binary denotes execution status. Training terminal progress Score excluded from this task-time classification.

feedback_observation.evidence: Preview returns image; executor stdout/stderr and traceback.

memory_time.evidence: Context appends tokens and tool responses every turn; episode state reset.
memory_time.reasoning: Retained within episode, not cross-run memory.

memory_reach.evidence: ctx is supplied to the single editing agent.
memory_reach.reasoning: Role-local conversation context, no shared multi-agent store.

action_type.evidence: Tool calls carry arbitrary bpy code or a camera preview request.

graphics_software.evidence: BlenderHTTP addon and unified proxy expose execution, preview and state export.

tools.reasoning: Execution Utilities runs scripts and captures errors; Graphics Operations edit and render scene. No metric solver tool inferred for task-time agent.

resources.evidence: Tool signatures supplied; material tasks provide initial setup script as Infinigen API reference.
resources.reasoning: Interface rules/reference implementation are explicitly provided reusable guidance. Source assets for training are not a task-time retrieval resource.

representation.evidence: bpy actions, explicit Blender scene, rendered previews.
representation.reasoning: Code specifies edits; Geometry is manipulated scene; Pixels provide rendered observations.

papers.contribution: Unifies perturbation-based editing tasks, a deterministic Blender sandbox, and SFT/RL for open-weight reactive 3D editors; 8B placement SR@0.5 rises from 1.5% to 36%.
papers.limitations: Four controlled editing families and goal images dominate evaluation; some shape-key base meshes overlap across splits; held-out camera validity is at most 35%; other DCC transfer untested and main comparisons lack significance intervals.
taxonomy_delta: Planning remains Not Reported: autonomous tool choice does not itself establish an explicit plan. Terminal RL metrics are separate from inference feedback.

papers.canonical_title: ManimCode: Learning Visual Self-Correction for Educational Animation
papers.abstract: ManimData preserves render errors, visual critiques and corrective revisions in 24,034 verified educational animation records. ManimCode learns Writer, Reviewer and Reviser roles in a single 4B multimodal model with supervised trajectories and reinforcement learning on self-generated failure states.

events.evidence: Canonical history: sole v1, Chicago November 5 10:55:44-06:00; manuscript cover date is not submission event.

papers.screening_reason: Trained multimodal roles write, visually judge and revise executable educational animation programs using runtime and geometric feedback.
screening_evidence: Secs.3.2,4.2 and Appendix A.3 specify task-time reuse of render–review–revise pipeline.
papers.analysis_target: ManimCode task-time scene-level educational animation generation using the trained 4B Writer/Reviewer/Reviser. Excludes the larger data-construction teacher, training-only reward model, and external long-form lecture planners.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Generates full Manim programs, critiques rendered frames and rewrites code using retrieved API cards
agent_graphics_relation.graphics_target: Executable educational animations and their rendered videos
agent_graphics_relation.evidence: Single 4B model performs all roles at inference; reviews and layout/runtime diagnostics drive subsequent program revisions.

task.evidence: Creates educational animations showing concepts unfolding over time.

input_form.evidence: Inference begins with open request, no reference video/code.

output.evidence: Retains best successfully rendered candidate program and video.
output.reasoning: Program is the editable generated content; Rendered Media is the delivered educational video.

model_type.evidence: One Qwen3.5-4B handles program writing and reviewing sampled frames.
model_type.reasoning: Decision-making backbone consumes visual and textual information, hence VLM.

model_training.evidence: Role-conditioned LoRA SFT followed by RLOO Reviser optimization.

planning.evidence: No explicit task plan for scene generator; lecture plans belong to external long-form systems.
planning.reasoning: Fixed revision schedule alone does not prove a represented plan; do not import external planner.

workflow.evidence: Write, render, review and revise sequentially up to ten renders.
workflow.reasoning: Failure skips review but remains a single correction path, not independent parallel branches.

update_strategy.evidence: Reviser rewrites full program; keep best candidate; use best revision base when alignment/completeness drop exceeds 0.5.
update_strategy.reasoning: Full rewrite supports Regeneration even when diff small; best output supports Candidate Selection; explicit return to best base supports Rollback.

verifier.evidence: Reviewer role gives scores/critiques; layout checker flags geometric defects; renderer reports errors.
verifier.reasoning: Critic denotes distinct review role despite shared weights; Programmatic layout rules and Environment runtime both affect next revision.

feedback_assessment.evidence: Four 1–5 scores, critiques, geometric diagnostics and render success/failure.
feedback_assessment.reasoning: Scores gate selection; Diagnosis directs changes; Binary rendering outcome routes repair. Pairwise RL rewards and Gemini final metrics excluded.

feedback_observation.evidence: Eight sampled frames; object positions at pauses; renderer execution errors.
feedback_observation.reasoning: Frames are Visual; object geometry is Structural Scene State; errors are Runtime.

memory_time.evidence: Current/best programs, scores and previous critiques retained across revisions within request.
memory_time.reasoning: Explicit episode-local retained state supports Short-Term Memory; training data is not agent memory.

memory_reach.evidence: One backbone handles all roles, with current code passed to Reviewer and Reviser and review used by reviser.
memory_reach.reasoning: Common program/review state is shared across the role-conditioned pipeline rather than a private role store.

action_type.evidence: Writer and Reviser emit complete executable Manim programs.

graphics_software.evidence: Harness integrates Manim renderer, extracted layout checks, review frames and retrieval.
graphics_software.reasoning: Dedicated feedback adapter around general renderer; more than direct scripting alone.

tools.evidence: Program execution/rendering plus layout checker at animation pauses.
tools.reasoning: Execution Utilities executes and captures errors; Graphics Operations render animations; Static Validator checks overlaps/frame bounds.

resources.evidence: Retrieves cards with API documentation, rules, recipes and verified example scenes.
resources.reasoning: Documentation & Rules includes API/caveats; Examples & Trajectories covers explicitly retrieved example scenes, not stored training corpus.

representation.evidence: Manim programs, rendered frames and object/label positions.
representation.reasoning: Code is executable animation; Pixels are review frames; Layouts are structured educational visual objects.

papers.contribution: Learns visual self-correction in a 4B model from complete revision trajectories; SFT+RL reaches 96.6%/97.0% render success versus 52.6%/82.0% untrained model under the same loop.
papers.limitations: Revisions can oscillate between overlap and clipping; best-score retention does not remove all defects. Human check used one blinded team annotator and 98 pairs; weak judge agreement for small quality gaps. Long-form planning is external and judge replacement prevents direct comparison with original published scores.
taxonomy_delta: Critic denotes a distinct Reviewer role even though all roles share one backbone; alternative Self interpretation remains a codebook boundary.
Small code diffs are emitted as whole-program rewrites, classified Regeneration rather than Local Patch.

papers.canonical_title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video-Coder trains a multimodal agent to write, execute and revise Blender programs for dynamic white-model draft videos that guide downstream realistic video generation. SFT and harness-native GRPO use execution validity and video consistency rewards with an annealed weighting.

events.evidence: Sole version in canonical history; Chicago November 6 12:59:57-06:00.

papers.screening_reason: Multimodal coding agent directly constructs and revises dynamic Blender scene programs using static, runtime, structural and visual observations.
screening_evidence: Sec.3.2 p.5 and Appendix A pp.12–14 give exact executable interface and feedback-driven loop.
papers.analysis_target: Task-time trained Video-Coder-9B scene-programming agent producing draft animations; downstream frozen video generator and training-only video reward judge are separate components.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Writes Blender scripts, invokes check_script/run_blender and revises motion/layout/camera code
agent_graphics_relation.evidence: Agent uses shell to edit script, executes in Blender, observes frame images and scene summaries, and changes code until acceptable.

task.evidence: Dynamic scenes specify motion timing and camera movement and render animation.
task.reasoning: Animation is the principal graphics objective; optional physics is an implementation route, not universal simulation task.

input_form.evidence: Given text prompt c, agent writes Blender program.

output.evidence: One self-contained script submitted; re-rendered video exported as final draft.
output.reasoning: Program and rendered draft are products; .blend output is expressly forbidden so no Graphics Artifact label.

model_type.evidence: Qwen3.5-9B trained as multimodal coding agent consuming frame observations.

model_training.evidence: SFT followed by GRPO multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning.

planning.evidence: Fixed Think & Plan step requires explicit reasoning on objects, dimensions, positions, frame timing and camera before code.
planning.reasoning: Hybrid: fixed stage scaffold with model-produced scene-specific plan content.

workflow.evidence: Plan, write, static check, run/render, repair, submit.
workflow.reasoning: Single ordered iterative path; independent training rollouts excluded.

update_strategy.evidence: Shell edits script; explicit rewrite or sed -i repair supported.
update_strategy.reasoning: Rewrite supports Regeneration; in-place script edits support Local Patch. Each execution rebuilds scene rather than persisting Blender state.

verifier.evidence: Agent inspects frames, static checker flags invalid code, renderer reports tracebacks and content checks.
verifier.reasoning: Self visual diagnosis, Programmatic static/content checks, Environment runtime errors affect next action; terminal-only reward judge excluded.

feedback_assessment.evidence: RUN OK, syntax/runtime errors and concrete visual problems guide correction.
feedback_assessment.reasoning: Binary execution validity and Diagnosis explain fixes. RL video Score is not inference-loop feedback.

feedback_observation.evidence: Sampled frames; object counts/positions/animated objects; traceback.
feedback_observation.reasoning: Frames are Visual, scene summaries Structural Scene State, errors Runtime.

memory_time.evidence: Policy conditions on previous programs, feedback and videos; script persists in task directory.
memory_time.reasoning: State retained across episode turns, not cross-run memory.

memory_reach.reasoning: Local agent context; downstream generator is not another shared-memory controller.

action_type.evidence: Python program written via shell; named checking and rendering commands.
action_type.reasoning: Code/Script expresses graphics; Tool/Function Call invokes harness commands.

graphics_software.evidence: Isolated Blender harness exposes tools, summaries and frame feedback.
graphics_software.reasoning: Dedicated adapter built over native Blender.

tools.evidence: check_script and run_blender with shell editing.
tools.reasoning: Static Validator checks program; Execution Utilities shell/run; Graphics Operations builds and renders animated scene.

resources.evidence: Explicit API/render contract and command rules; external assets prohibited.
resources.reasoning: Documentation & Rules is supplied executable interface contract; no Assets or retrieved Examples inferred.

representation.evidence: Scripts construct primitives, animate keyframes/drivers/physics and render frames.
representation.reasoning: Code program; Geometry meshes; Dynamic State motion; Pixels rendered video.

papers.contribution: Trains draft-scene coding agents with annealed execution/video rewards. Tables show PhyGenBench 0.61 to 0.67 and VBench-2.0 54.58% to 78.19% for MiniMax-H3.
papers.limitations: Reporting inconsistencies: datasets called 6k/2k in method but 10k/4k in setup/conclusion; OmniWeaving 0.48 to 0.51 is incorrectly described as 16.28 points. Primitive/keyframe-biased prompt filtering and gray drafts constrain appearance/material phenomena. No dedicated limitations section; evaluation relies on model judges.
taxonomy_delta: Training video judge and its scores excluded from task-time feedback. Dynamic scene generation classified Animation, not automatically Simulation.

papers.canonical_title: CADFather: Autonomous CAD Reconstruction through Coordinated Tool Use
papers.abstract: CADFather reconstructs editable CadQuery programs from target meshes. A vision-language assistant chooses candidate branches, learned or algorithmic operation proposals, parameter optimization and proposal budgets using rendered and measured geometry. Protected best retention supports search without additional model training.

events.evidence: Canonical history sole v1; Chicago October 6 16:20:59-05:00. Authorized older pending backlog, not seven-day catch-up.

source_records.source: canonical page and authorized prior pending history

papers.screening_reason: VLM explicitly selects tools and alternative executable CAD candidates; rendered geometry and numerical validity/fidelity govern subsequent actions.
screening_evidence: Sections 3.2–3.6 pp.4–7 specify candidate graph, act calls and feedback.
papers.analysis_target: Task-time CADFather VLM assistant coordinating mesh-to-CAD candidate search. Learned proposal generator is a tool, not the controller whose adaptation is classified.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Chooses candidate IDs, proposal/optimization tools and sample allocation; accepts geometry and terminates
agent_graphics_relation.graphics_target: Editable CadQuery-based CAD programs and generated solid meshes
agent_graphics_relation.evidence: Assistant issues up to four act calls; executed proposals undergo validity checks and visual acceptance before becoming selectable candidates.

task.evidence: Recover executable parametric CAD program matching target mesh.

model_type.evidence: Qwen3.8-27B assistant inspects target and candidate renders.

model_training.evidence: Both models frozen; assistant and generator need no additional training.

planning.evidence: One short next-step rationale and up to four act calls; no explicit multi-step task plan specified.
planning.reasoning: Tool selection and search do not establish explicit planning degree; costs called planning in limitations are not a plan representation.

workflow.evidence: Parent-linked candidate branches can be revisited or extended from root.
workflow.reasoning: Explicit nonlinear search graph, not a single sequential revision chain.

update_strategy.evidence: Return to earlier candidate/root, append operations or refine parameters; protected best returned.
update_strategy.reasoning: Candidate Selection ranks alternatives; Local Patch changes a selected program's operations/parameters; Rollback revisits preserved earlier state without overwriting history.

verifier.evidence: Assistant visually accepts; programmatic watertightness and measurements; execution failures reported.
verifier.reasoning: Self checks visual outcomes; Programmatic gates geometry and scores; Environment reports build/time failures.

feedback_assessment.evidence: Validity, IoU/GMS scores, reasons unavailable action and one-sentence geometry rationale.
feedback_assessment.reasoning: Binary gates admission; Score guides search; Diagnosis guides subsequent action correction.

feedback_observation.evidence: Renders, structured candidate table and execution status.
feedback_observation.reasoning: Visual images; Structural Scene State program/geometry metrics; Runtime build failures.

memory_time.evidence: Retains candidates and executed action transcript across steps for each part.
memory_time.reasoning: Short-term per-part search memory, not across runs.

memory_reach.evidence: Assistant receives bounded candidate table and transcript; tools receive selected parent.
memory_reach.reasoning: Memory is local to the single assistant/harness; no multi-agent global store asserted.

graphics_software.evidence: Shared CadQuery DSL wrapped with agent candidate/tool interface.
graphics_software.reasoning: Adapter to CAD execution, not native agent-ready CadQuery.

tools.evidence: CADENA-RL generator, geometric proposals, distance optimizer, validation, execution/rendering.
tools.reasoning: Graphics Operations construct; Perception models learned geometry-conditioned proposal tool; Solver Validator explores fitted parameter states; Static Validator tests watertightness; Execution Utilities build and measure.

resources.evidence: Fixed rules describe task, objective, tools, cost and answer format.

representation.evidence: CAD programs, meshes and rendered images.
representation.reasoning: Code construction sequence, Geometry solids, Pixels observations.

papers.contribution: Coordinates complementary CAD proposal/refinement tools with persistent best-candidate search. DeepCAD mean IoU 0.987 versus published CADENA-RL sampling 0.966; algorithmic proposals explain most ablation gain.
papers.limitations: No controlled isolation of assistant policy; baseline compute and input protocols differ. Token costs omit geometry processing. Reconstruction metrics do not establish manufacturing intent, assembly constraints or design-history recovery. Wrong initial topology and resource exhaustion remain failures.
taxonomy_delta: No planning degree inferred from adaptive search or brief next-action rationale.
Rollback denotes revisiting preserved earlier candidate; branch retention need not imply destructive undo.

papers.canonical_title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
papers.abstract: CADForge decomposes a single RGB object image into ordered CAD components, computes explicit geometric parameters, synthesizes CadQuery programs and uses visual review to route targeted corrections. Compact parameter memory and failure-mined reusable helpers improve consistency and efficiency.

events.evidence: Canonical sole v1; Chicago October 2 22:39:54-05:00. Authorized older pending backlog, outside seven-day window.

papers.screening_reason: Image-grounded planner and geometry/code agents directly create editable B-reps, with review routing failures to geometric reasoning or code construction.
screening_evidence: Secs.3.2–3.5 pp.3–6; exact role prompts Appendix G pp.23–32.
papers.analysis_target: Main GPT-5.5 task-time single-image CAD reconstruction pipeline. Offline helper-library construction and optional texture/articulation/editing extensions remain separate notes.

agent_graphics_relation.controller: GPT-5.5 component planner, geometry observer/programmer, code and review roles
agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Orders components, selects references, writes mathematical and CadQuery code, routes review-triggered corrections
agent_graphics_relation.graphics_target: Part-aware parametric CAD programs and B-rep geometry
agent_graphics_relation.evidence: Code synthesizes each component, executes in CAD kernel, and review rejects mismatched shape/placement to trigger targeted revisions.

task.evidence: Reconstruct object as components of B-rep shapes and CadQuery programs.
task.reasoning: Static CAD reconstruction is Modeling; optional articulation not mixed into main configuration.

input_form.evidence: Single RGB image is the task input.

output.evidence: Part programs and B-reps; STEP, STL and GLB exports.
output.reasoning: Program is editable construction code; Graphics Artifact is CAD geometry.

model_type.evidence: All agentic roles use GPT-5.5; image-facing planner/reviewer and text-only code role.
model_type.reasoning: One VLM backbone across roles; code-only input for one role does not establish a distinct LLM architecture or Hybrid.

planning.evidence: VLM creates dependency-ordered component inventory under fixed decomposition/geometry/code/review scaffold.
planning.reasoning: Explicit learned object-specific plan inside hard-coded stages supports PO-2.

workflow.evidence: Reviewer branches back to geometry or code synthesis depending on diagnosed cause; parts reference prior components.
workflow.reasoning: Substantive conditional routing and dependency structure support Graph-Structured rather than plain serial pipeline.

update_strategy.evidence: Re-observe and replace current component program; technical repair changes only failed operation.
update_strategy.reasoning: Regeneration produces complete replacement observation/program at component level; Local Patch captures smallest-operation repair while accepted components remain untouched.

verifier.evidence: Separate Review Agent, static/validity checks, execution errors.
verifier.reasoning: Critic visual review; Programmatic validity gates; Environment execution failures control repair.

feedback_assessment.evidence: pass versus geometry_error/modeling_error/mixed_error with key notes.
feedback_assessment.reasoning: Binary acceptance and Diagnosis route next changes; geometric metrics and rank preferences are final evaluation, not feedback scores.

feedback_observation.evidence: Review comparison images; execution/static-validation error messages.
feedback_observation.reasoning: Visual discrepancy and Runtime errors are loop evidence. Reference parameter memory is conditioning state, not a separately reported verifier observation.

memory_time.evidence: Accepted component parameter dictionaries retained and queried for later parts.
memory_time.reasoning: Object-local cross-call memory is Short-Term; offline helper evolution is not task-time Long-Term memory.

memory_reach.evidence: Selected reference parameters passed to geometry/program/code stages; reviewer receives image and semantic target, not whole dictionary.
memory_reach.reasoning: Stage-scoped access rather than Global Memory accessible to all agents.

action_type.evidence: Pure Python geometry program and CadQuery scripts are emitted.

graphics_software.evidence: Toolkit, API manifest and automated VTK rendering/review wrap CadQuery.
graphics_software.reasoning: Agent-oriented layer added to general CAD software.

tools.evidence: Python execution, CAD helpers/rendering, syntax and geometry validity checks.
tools.reasoning: Execution Utilities runs code; Graphics Operations builds/renders geometry; Static Validator checks outputs. Pure math formulas do not establish a state-search Solver Validator.

papers.abstract: Reels-RSI treats explainer video as editable script/storyboard/frame programs. Logged revisions become human-curated lessons and tested static rules that can audit prior output. A gated playbook-evolution procedure is evaluated alongside 111 reels, exposing limitations of memory growth and biased visual preference judgments.

L1/L2 memory induction and L3 playbook evolution are described separately; L3 ranking is not mixed into task-time feedback.

papers.abstract: The retrieved v2 PDF retrospectively audits 2,333 saved model calls and 30 game episodes, comparing formalization, function construction and verification. It finds endpoint-only negative counterexamples, redundant symbolic geometry in all 187 image-arm requests, and a common curve satisfying 72 catalog scenes. This differs materially from the canonical abstract's earlier pilot description.

papers.canonical_title: Frontier3DBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for 3D Creation across Objects, Scenes, and Interactive Open Worlds
papers.abstract: Frontier3DBench evaluates 11 coding model–harness configurations on 145 object, scene and interactive-world tasks. Native Blender/Unreal projects are assessed for visual, structural and behavioral correctness; reference fidelity and coordinated persistent-state workflows remain major limitations.

papers.canonical_title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.abstract: MotionGraphicsBench pairs 100 SVG motion-edit tasks with deterministic requirement-level verification programs. A writer and independent animation-test synthesizer construct programs from human-labeled examples and targeted transformations. Programs agree with held-out human labels on 93.3% of 180 animations; broad model evaluation uses independent GSAP generations without report-driven repair.
papers.screening_reason: During benchmark construction, an agent explicitly transforms animation timing, geometry and appearance into counterexamples, and writer decisions revise graphics-verification programs against executable evidence.
screening_evidence: Sec.4.2 pp.5–7; Appendix B.2 pp.16–17. Test synthesizer emits deterministic transformations of source/approved animations.
papers.analysis_target: Benchmark-construction phase: GPT-6 Astra verification-program writer plus test-case synthesizer. Principal agentic contribution is counterexample-guided verifier construction; final 47-model pass@k study is independent one-shot generation, not an inference refinement loop.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Choose targeted deterministic animation transformations, challenge/repair test cases, revise SVG-animation verification checks

feedback_observation.reasoning: Structural Scene State includes per-node transforms/styles/time; Runtime captures errors. Visual examples are supplied inputs, not explicitly refreshed visual loop feedback.

memory_reach.reasoning: Deliberately role-local visibility, not all-agent global memory.

action_type.evidence: Python verification program and deterministic animation transformations are written.

graphics_software.evidence: Transformation/verification libraries and animation matrix around MoVer browser rendering.

tools.evidence: Transformation library, execution engine and deterministic motion checks.
tools.reasoning: Graphics Operations alters animations; Execution Utilities runs code; Static Validator checks measured motion requirements, not alternative-state solving.

resources.reasoning: Examples & Trajectories includes labeled animation examples; Documentation & Rules includes library guidance and prompt-specific requirements.

representation.reasoning: Code checks/transforms; Layouts SVG structures; Dynamic State temporal attributes; Pixels provided previews.

papers.contribution: Builds prompt-specific deterministic animation verifiers through multi-agent counterexample construction, reaching 93.3% agreement versus VLM baseline 83.3% on 180 balanced held-out animations.

papers.canonical_title: Simple Test-Time Refinement for Plot-to-Code Generation via Visual-Code Diagnostics
papers.abstract: A compact trained visual-code diagnostic model identifies chart errors and annotates suspicious code with add/modify/delete TODOs. A generator implements localized OLD/NEW patches and re-renders iteratively. SFT/GRPO diagnostics improve general-purpose generators but can degrade specialized generators lacking revision ability.

source_records.source: canonical abstract and history; selected after late title-hint review

papers.screening_reason: Diagnostician decides concrete add/modify/delete regions of graphics code, and generator executes local patches under render-grounded iterative feedback.
screening_evidence: Sec.3.2 p.5 equation 1; inference prompts pp.17–18 specify concrete OLD/NEW code modifications.
papers.analysis_target: Task-time visual-code diagnostic controller and patch generator, with the trained 2B diagnostician as the principal learned decision component. SFT/RL labels refer to diagnostic action localization, not claimed adaptation of the general-purpose patch generator; offline error mutation is separate.

agent_graphics_relation.action_or_decision: Identifies add/modify/delete regions and emits OLD/NEW local source patches

feedback_observation.reasoning: Visual identifies discrepancy; Runtime error identifies compiler/render failure.

memory_time.reasoning: Explicit retained source across calls is Short-Term memory; no longer diagnostic-history persistence inferred.

memory_reach.reasoning: Common artifact state shared across both roles.

tools.reasoning: Execution Utilities merges/executes; Graphics Operations plots; Perception models analyzes image/code. Offline Levenshtein training annotation is not task-time Static Validator.

resources.reasoning: Documentation & Rules covers explicit action-format definitions; no retrieval or reusable example access claimed.

representation.evidence: Python source, chart axes/elements/layout and rendered chart.
representation.reasoning: Code specifies plot; Layouts structures chart elements; Pixels diagnostic renderings.

papers.contribution: A trained 2B diagnostician improves chart code through local patches: GPT-4o ChartMimic visual score rises 81.6 to 87.6, with reported tokens 1,859 versus multi-agent 11,264.
papers.limitations: ChartMaster-7B degrades substantially despite trained or gold diagnostics, exposing revision-capability dependence. Training supervision is synthetic code mutation from 1,000 seeds. Fine style errors persist; no separate limitations section, significance intervals or runtime-cost study. Model naming inconsistencies occur between introductory model lists and later settings.
taxonomy_delta: Model training describes diagnostic action controller, not patch generator; no blanket fine-tuning claim for every component.
Local source changes are explicitly emitted as patches, unlike whole-program regeneration in ManimCode.
